implementation: Normalize DuckDuckGo HTML and lite relative, protocol-relative and wrapped result URLs through one pure helper.
Unwrap a single uddg destination once, preserve original-source query parameters and fragment, and deduplicate before applying the existing result count.
Reject non-HTTP(S), credentials, ambiguous redirect targets, known local names and non-public literal IPs using the existing address validator.
Empty or failed search remains empty; no synthetic source or fact fallback was added.

limits.dnsAndRedirectSsrfDefense: Not established by this syntactic/literal-address helper; existing scraper DNS and redirect behavior is unchanged.
limits.reason: This approved scope was local regressions and bounded real source acquisition, not production release or full three-role model execution.

checks: two mock model backends in one channel

live.execution: actual patched generated search and scrape functions; no full application or three-role model workflow

conclusion: The corrected generated product search/scrape path acquired one primary IANA source in this local bounded probe. This does not prove a complete deployed retriever/verifier/summarizer workflow.
